headline: NQ is +0.5% at its overnight high, pointing to a cash open above Monday's NDX high as the AI rebound continues. Small long only while NQ holds above Monday's settle; the Fed, Microsoft and Alphabet all land Wednesday.
session_note: Cash open 9:30 AM ET (10:30 AM Atlantic) · morning window

flip.long: Stays LONG while NQ holds above ~29,570 (≈ NDX 29,404, Monday's high) after the open. Adds conviction above the overnight high 29,627.75.
flip.short: NQ fills the gap and loses Monday's settle (29,437.25; ≈ NDX 29,273, Monday's close). Stronger below the overnight low (29,288), especially if oil jumps on Gulf headlines or the 10-year moves back above 5.00%.

thesis: There's a small long edge at the open, but it's low conviction. The NDX rose 1.1% Monday to 29,273.40 (range 29,011.91–29,404.44) on the Anthropic IPO filing [1,4]. Overnight, Nasdaq-100 futures firmed through the morning, from +0.1% at 5:30 AM to **+0.5–0.6% (~29,589–29,612) by 8:30–8:41 AM ET**, at the top of a 29,288.00–29,627.75 range [2,3,4]. With a ~164-pt futures premium, that implies a cash open near ~29,425, **above Monday's 29,404 high**, so it's an upside range break, not a gap inside the range [1,2]. Macro is neutral to mildly helpful. The 10-year is ~4.99%, just under 5% [6]. WTI is ~$101 and Brent ~$110, both lower on the day, though Gulf headlines (a reported strike on Ras Tanura, US evacuation of some Gulf embassy staff) keep oil jumpy [6,7,8]. The dollar is firmer at ~102.2 [6,7]. September durable goods rose 1.8% (ex-transport +0.5%); consensus differs by source [9,10]. The risk is Wednesday: the FOMC decision (~10% hike odds this week; **~81% for a December hike**), with Microsoft and Alphabet after the close [4,5]. Barron's calls the tape cautious, with rotation into defensives [5]. So the call is **a small LONG while NQ holds above Monday's high zone, out on a loss of Monday's settle**.

bullets.label: The gap is up, and it's above Monday's high.
bullets.text: NQ is +0.5–0.6% and trading near its overnight high of 29,627.75 [2,3]. On a ~164-pt premium, that implies a cash open around ~29,425, just above Monday's 29,404 NDX high, so the rebound from last week's AI selloff is extending [1,2]. That's an estimate, not a quote.

bullets.label: Futures firmed through the morning.
bullets.text: NQ was only +0.1% at 5:30 AM ET and briefly −0.2% around 6:20 AM, then climbed to +0.5–0.6% by 8:30 AM [3,4,7]. AI stocks are still running on Anthropic's public IPO prospectus, and Korean chip stocks led Asia higher [4]. Cadence (NDX) is up ~3% premarket after a beat-and-raise [7].

bullets.label: Macro is neutral to mildly helpful.
bullets.text: The 10-year is flat at ~4.99%, still just under 5%, and VIX is down to ~17.8 [6]. Oil is slightly lower (WTI ~$101) but jumpy on Gulf headlines [6,7,8]. The dollar is firmer at ~102.2 [6,7]. September durable goods rose 1.8% (ex-transport +0.5%), a mixed print with no clear market impact [9,10].

bullets.label: Today's calendar is light; Wednesday is heavy.
bullets.text: Still to come today: Richmond Fed and Dallas Fed services; no Fed speakers, since the FOMC starts its two-day meeting today [5,7]. Boeing, PayPal, SoFi and Coca-Cola reported before the open; Visa and Robinhood report after the close [8,11]. Microsoft and Alphabet report Wednesday after the Fed decision [4,5].

bullets.label: Bull case:
bullets.text: Monday's +1.1% was a solid follow-through day after two flat closes, and the open looks set to break above Monday's high with VIX falling [1,6]. With yields capped near 5% and oil off its highs, positioning ahead of Microsoft and Alphabet could lift NDX back toward the 29,822 level from before the selloff [1,6].

bullets.label: Bear case:
bullets.text: Barron's describes a cautious tape: chip buying is fading and money is rotating into defensives ahead of Wednesday [5]. Newsquawk had NQ lagging ES/YM earlier this morning [7]. December hike odds are ~81%, debt-funded AI spending (Meta's $97.5B equity raise) is still a concern, and Gulf headlines could push oil and short-end yields up quickly [5,8,12]. A gap into heavy event risk can easily fade back to Monday's settle.

bullets.label: Stay/scale LONG:
bullets.text: Cash NDX holds above Monday's 29,404 high (≈ NQ 29,568) through the first 30 min. Add on a break of the NQ overnight high 29,627.75, ideally with SMH green and the 10-year under 5.00%.

bullets.label: Flip to SHORT:
bullets.text: NQ fills the gap and loses Monday's settle (29,437.25; ≈ NDX 29,273). Stronger below the overnight low (29,288), especially if WTI moves back above ~$103 or the 10-year holds above 5.00%.

bullets.label: Flip to STAND ASIDE:
bullets.text: If the open stalls in the 29,437–29,568 NQ band (between Monday's settle and its high) with no follow-through, there's no edge. Go flat into Wednesday.

bullets.label: Wildcards:
bullets.text: US–Iran/Gulf headlines (Ras Tanura, embassy evacuations), Anthropic IPO news, Meta's equity raise, Israeli election exit polls at 4:00 PM ET, and any Fed leak before Wednesday [7,8,12].
